main_text.l: I. Si immutabili Dei decreto uni-cuiquè
fixa eft aut vita,aut mors,nihil in-
tereft quomodo fe gerat, quia fuo opere
tio. Et fic deploratum in morem,
2. Scit Deus quid de nobis agere
femel ftatuerit: fi falutem decrevit adducet
nos ad eam fuo tempore, fi mortem
3. Securos fe in vitiis pergere dicunt,
qui fi fint in numero electorum

page.notes: Part 1 of 2; the text continues below and is not transcribed here. Running head is in small capitals. The ornamental rule above the heading is a printer's ornament, not transcribed. Spelling in the heading is as printed ("praedestinatione", "deducta" with ct ligature rendered as ct). The "s" long s rendered as s throughout. Nothing printed in the margins. The last line "nihil" is set flush right at the foot of the column, apparently a catchword.
